note: Provenance classification for the governance EVIDENCE-artifact surface (artifacts/academy_fellow/, artifacts/physics_v2/, claims_hashes.json, docs/architecture/claim_graph.json). Every evidence artifact carries a determinism_class so trust is uniform, not mixed. The freshness gate (scripts/ci/check_artifact_freshness.py) regenerates each `deterministic` artifact and asserts byte-identical to the committed file; `nondeterministic`/`external-data-bound`/`generated-but-excluded` artifacts require an exclusion_reason and are not byte-compared. A new evidence artifact without an entry here fails the gate (no silent unclassified trust).

artifacts.exclusion_reason: Produced by a VERDICT GATE (check_physics_law_witness_index.py), not a pure generator: --write is coupled to mutable on-disk state and can exit non-zero mid-pipeline. Byte-freshness is enforced by its own dedicated gate step in phd_evidence.sh, not by re-running the gate as a generator here.

Produced by a VERDICT GATE (check_physics_inference_readiness.py) that recomputes from the law-witness index; re-running it as a generator is order/state-coupled and can exit non-zero. Byte-freshness is enforced by its own dedicated gate step in phd_evidence.sh.

Timestamped readiness RECEIPT emitted by a VERDICT GATE (check_physics_law_witness_index.py --write) — carries a mutable generated_utc field, so it is not bit-reproducible on re-run. Same rationale as physics_v2/law_witness_index.json and inference_readiness.json; freshness of the underlying index is enforced by that gate's own step, not by re-running it here.
